headline: PVR INOX Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Promoter entities (Pavan Kumar Jain, Siddharth Jain, Nayantara Jain, GFL Limited, INOX Infrastructure Limited) filed Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in PVR INOX Limited. Disclosure mechanism triggered acquisition by promoter group entities crossing regulatory thresholds.
detail: Pavan Kumar Jain, Siddharth Jain, and Nayantara Jain (natural persons) along with their holding entities GFL Limited and INOX Infrastructure Limited filed disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the National Stock Exchange. The disclosure was submitted on 30 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisitions by persons in control or concert; the filing suggests an acquisition crossing 25% or other material thresholds. No open offer announcement or exemption details are apparent from the primary disclosure document.
